property_summary: For any callee that ALWAYS succeeds (i.e. its fallback does not revert), calling c.forward(callee, data) returns (does not revert) for the reference implementation; the mutant inverts the success check and thus will revert when the callee call succeeds, so there exist inputs (a callee that succeeds and arbitrary data) that make the mutant fail while the reference always succeeds.
change_summary: Invert the success check to require the call to fail (require(!_s)), causing forward to revert on successful callee calls and only proceed when the callee call returns false, altering observable behavior.
